items.body_raw: וַתִּשָּׁחֵת הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ חָמָס
items.answer_raw: And the earth was corrupted before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

items.body_raw: And the earth was filled with blood (acc.).
items.answer_raw: וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ דָּמִים

items.body_raw: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶת־קוֹל יהוה מִתְהַלֵּךְ בַּגָּן לְרוּחַ הַיּוֹם וַיִּתְחַבֵּא הָאָדָם וְאִשְׁתּוֹ מִפְּנֵי יהוה
items.answer_raw: And they heard the voice of Yahweh as he walked in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahweh.
The asses are found which thou wentest to seek.
And God created man in his (own) image.
And the broad open places of the city shall be filled with boys and girls.
Seek ye Yahweh, while he letteth himself be found.

items.body_raw: The serpent deceived her and she took of the tree and gave to her husband.
items.answer_raw: הַנָּחָשׁ הִשִּׁיאָהּ וַתִּקַּח מִן־הָעֵץ וַתִּתֵּן לְאִישָׁהּ
If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat.

items.body_raw: And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me and I ate.
items.answer_raw: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַנָּחָשׁ הִשִּׁיאַנִי וָאֹכֵל

items.body_raw: וַיְבָרְכוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר יְבָרֶכְךָ יהוה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ יִשָּׂא יהוה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ
items.answer_raw: And the priests blessed the Israelites, saying, Yahweh bless thee and keep thee, Yahweh lift up his face towards thee.
We will create (1 pl. impf. Qal); or he was created (3 s. m. pf. Niph.); or (the) one (or thing) that has been created (ptc. Niph.)
Thou wilt (or she will) cause to sin (Hiph.)
And ye will sin (pf. Qal)
Ye will sin (impf. Qal)
I have filled (Pi.) thee (m.)
Call ye (2 plur. fem. imper. with loss of the ה, for קְרֶאנָה: Ruth 1:20)
And they found him
He will cause him to find (Hiph. with nûn energ., Job 34:11)
We fear (§ 22. 6) or we feared (1 pl. pf. Qal)
I will or would (or let me) be filled (cohortative Niph., § 23. 1. 2)
He will lift me up (or take me away; impf. Qal of נשׂא)

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל־בָּנָיו הֵאָסְפוּ וְאַגִּידָה לָכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֶתְכֶם בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים
items.answer_raw: And Jacob said to his sons, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you what shall befall you in the days to come.

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׂנֵאתִיו כִּי לֹא יִתְנַבֵּא עָלַי טוֹב כִּי אִם רָע
items.answer_raw: And the king of Israel said, I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but evil.

items.body_raw: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁרְצוּ וַיַּעַצְמוּ וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ אֹתָם
items.answer_raw: And the Israelites swarmed and grew strong, and the land was filled with them.

items.body_raw: כֹּה אָמַר יהוה אֲנִי מַרְעִישׁ אֶת־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִם וּמִלֵּאתִי אֶת־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה כָּבוֹד
items.answer_raw: Thus saith Yahweh, I am about to shake all the nations, and I will fill this house with glory.

items.body_raw: נִמְצֵאתִי לַאֲשֶׁר לֹא בִקְשֻׁנִי אָמַרְתִּי הִנֵּנִי הִנֵּנִי אֶל־גּוֹי לֹא קֹרָא בִשְׁמִי
items.answer_raw: I have let myself be found by those who did not seek me; I have said, Here am I, here am I, to a nation that was not called by my name.

items.body_raw: אמר הכהן הגדול ספר התורה מצאתי ויתן את־הספר אל־הספר ויקראהו
items.answer_raw: The high priest said, I have found the book of the law, and he gave the book to the secretary, and he read it.
And a man found him and asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

items.body_raw: Yahweh will hear when thou criest to him.
items.answer_raw: יִשְׁמַע יְהוָה בְּקָרְאֲךָ אֵלָיו

items.body_raw: I am full (perf.) of the spirit of judgment and of power, to tell to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.
items.answer_raw: מָלֵאתִי רוּחַ מִשְׁפָּט וּגְבוּרָה לְהַגִּיד לְיַעֲקֹב פִּשְׁעוֹ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל חַטָּאתוֹ

items.body_raw: And the earth was filled with violence.
items.answer_raw: וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ חָמָס

items.body_raw: Hast thou found-me, mine enemy? and he said, I have found-thee.
items.answer_raw: הַמְצָאתַנִי אֹיְבִי וַיֹּאמֶר מְצָאתִיךָ

items.body_raw: Thou hast filled this house with thy glory.
items.answer_raw: מִלֵּאתָ אֶת־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֶת־כְּבוֹדֶךָ

items.body_raw: Thou hatest (perf.) all workers of iniquity.
items.answer_raw: שָׂנֵאתָ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן

items.body_raw: And the spirit of Yahweh lifted-him up and cast him to-(the)-earth.
items.answer_raw: וַתִּשָּׂאֵהוּ רוּחַ יְהוָה וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה

items.body_raw: Thou shalt love thine enemy, thou shalt not hate him in thy heart.
items.answer_raw: תֶּאֱהַב אֶת־אֹיִבְךָ לֹא תִשְׂנָאֵהוּ בִּלְבָבֶךָ

items.body_raw: Unless ye had ploughed (perf.) with my heifer, ye would not have found (perf.) my riddle.
items.answer_raw: לוּלֵא חֲרַשְׁתֶּם בְּעֶגְלָתִי לֹא מְצָאתֶם חִידָתִי

items.body_raw: וישמעו את־קול יהוה מתהלך בתוך עץ הגן לרוח היום ויתחבא האדם ואשתו מפניו
items.answer_raw: And they heard the voice of Yahweh as he walked in the midst of the trees of the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from his presence.
Our end is near, our days are fulfilled.

items.body_raw: Comfort ye my people, speak to (עַל־) their heart, and cry unto them that their warfare is fulfilled (full).
items.answer_raw: נַחֲמוּ עַמִּי דַּבְּרוּ עַל־לִבּוֹ וְקִרְאוּ אֵלָיו כִּי מָלְאָה צְבָאוֹ

items.body_raw: וַיֶּחֱלֶא הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּרַגְלָיו וְגַם־בְּחָלְיוֹ לֹא דָרַשׁ אֶת־יהוה
items.answer_raw: And the king was diseased in his feet, yet in his disease he sought not Yahweh.

items.body_raw: I have found in thy house vessels of silver and gold.
items.answer_raw: מָצָאתִי בְּבֵיתְךָ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב

items.body_raw: וְנִבְחַר מָוֶת מֵחַיִּים לְכֹל הַנִּשְׁאָרִים מִן־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת
items.answer_raw: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all that are left of this evil family.
I have sinned against Yahweh.
God called the light day.
I have found the book of the instruction.
Heal me, Yahweh.
Pardon the iniquity of this people.
I hate falsehood.
He lifted up his eyes.
He called on the name of Yahweh.
Many camels
